title: Fable 5 vs. GPT-5.6 Sol on an NP-Hard Problem: Does /goal help?
summary: Researchers evaluated the performance of Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol large language models on an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem to test the impact of goal-directed prompting. By appending a '/goal' directive to the system prompt, the study measured correctness, token usage, and computational efficiency across multiple iterations. Results showed that explicit goal-oriented framing significantly mitigates planning drift and improves logical consistency in these frontier reasoning models. (source: https://charlesazam.com/blog/fable-5-gpt-5-6-sol-goal/)
title_cn: Fable 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 在 NP-hard 问题上的表现：/goal 指令有帮助吗？
summary_cn: 研究人员评估了 Fable 5 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 大语言模型在 NP-hard 组合优化问题上的表现，以测试目标导向提示（goal-directed prompting）的影响。通过在系统提示词中附加“/goal”指令，该研究测量了多轮迭代中的正确性、Token 使用量和计算效率。结果表明，明确的目标导向框架能显著缓解规划漂移，并提高这些前沿推理模型的逻辑一致性。

title: GPT-5.6 used a prompt to close a 30-year gap in convex optimization
summary: Following OpenAI's CDC mathematical proof announcement, reports indicate that the GPT-5.6 model has resolved a thirty-year-old theoretical gap in convex optimization. By utilizing a highly specialized and structured prompt, the large language model identified novel mathematical formulations that had eluded human researchers for decades. This milestone highlights the capability of advanced generative AI to assist in complex scientific discovery and accelerate rigorous mathematical proofs. (source: https://old.reddit.com/r/math/comments/1uxj3cy/after_openais_cdc_proof_announcement_gpt56_used_a/)
title_cn: GPT-5.6 利用提示词填补了凸优化领域 30 年的空白
summary_cn: 继 OpenAI 发布 CDC 数学证明公告后，有报道指出 GPT-5.6 模型解决了凸优化领域一个长达三十年的理论空白。通过使用高度专业化且结构化的提示词，该大语言模型识别出了人类研究人员几十年来一直未能发现的新型数学公式。这一里程碑凸显了先进生成式 AI 在协助复杂科学发现及加速严谨数学证明方面的能力。

title: The Kimi K3 Moment
summary: This technical analysis outlines the release and impact of the Kimi K3 conversational AI model. The author details how the model introduces a paradigm shift in deep reasoning, context window capacity, and computational architectural efficiency. These developments challenge traditional assumptions regarding prompt length limitations and computational bottlenecks, enabling new applications for enterprise-grade autonomous agents and complex document analysis. (source: https://stephen.bochinski.dev/blog/2026/07/18/the-kimi-k3-moment/)
summary_cn: 这份技术分析概述了 Kimi K3 对话式 AI 模型的发布及其影响。作者详细介绍了该模型如何在深度推理、上下文窗口容量和计算架构效率方面带来范式转变。这些进展挑战了关于提示长度限制和计算瓶颈的传统假设，为企业级自主智能体和复杂文档分析开启了新的应用场景。

title: Setting up your spare Mac for Claude Code to control, a step-by-step guide
summary: This technical guide provides instructions for configuring a secondary macOS device to be remotely managed by Claude Code, Anthropic's command-line developer agent. The author details the security measures, SSH configurations, system permissions, and shell environments required to delegate execution safely. Isolating the terminal-based AI assistant on a spare machine allows developers to safely test and debug code in a physical sandbox environment. (source: https://ykdojo.github.io/claude-controls-mac/)
title_cn: 如何设置闲置 Mac 以供 Claude Code 控制：分步指南
summary_cn: 本技术指南提供了配置辅助 macOS 设备以供 Anthropic 的命令行开发者智能体 Claude Code 进行远程管理的说明。作者详细介绍了授权执行所需的安全性措施、SSH 配置、系统权限和 shell 环境设置。将基于终端的 AI 助手隔离在备用机器上，可以让开发人员在物理沙箱环境中安全地测试和调试代码。

title: What AI did to stackoverflow in a graph
summary: A visual data analysis utilizing Stack Exchange data tracks a significant decline in developer engagement and traffic on Stack Overflow. The data highlights a major workflow shift as developers increasingly migrate their code generation and debugging queries away from traditional community-driven Q&A forums and toward conversational large language models and generative AI assistants. (source: https://data.stackexchange.com/stackoverflow/query/1953768#graph)
title_cn: 图表揭示 AI 对 Stack Overflow 的影响
summary_cn: 一份利用 Stack Exchange 数据进行的视觉分析显示，Stack Overflow 的开发者参与度和流量出现显著下滑。数据凸显了工作流的重大转变，开发者正日益将代码生成和调试查询的需求从传统的社区驱动问答论坛转向对话式大语言模型和生成式 AI 助手。

title: Anthropic Increases Claude Code Usage Limits Through August 19
summary: Anthropic has announced a temporary 50% increase in usage limits for Claude Code, its AI-powered developer assistant tool. This capacity boost applies immediately to all paid user tiers, including Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise subscribers, and will remain active through August 19. The adjustment is designed to support developers in executing complex coding workflows and intensive project experimentation without running into standard token restrictions. (source: https://x.com/ClaudeDevs/status/2078511173759324328)
title_cn: Anthropic 将 Claude Code 使用限额延长至 8 月 19 日
summary_cn: Anthropic 宣布其 AI 驱动的开发者助手工具 Claude Code 的使用限额将临时增加 50%。此容量提升即刻适用于所有付费用户层级，包括 Pro、Max、Team 以及基于席位的企业订阅用户，并将持续至 8 月 19 日。此次调整旨在支持开发者在执行复杂编码工作流和密集项目实验时，不受标准 Token 限制的影响。

title: The Disconnect Between Instruction Following And Sound Decision Making In AI Models
summary: AI researcher Francois Chollet highlighted a growing divergence in generative model capabilities, noting that while systems show exponential improvements in following precise instructions, their autonomous decision-making in novel environments has plateaued. Current architectures excel at rule-based procedural execution but fail to generalize when encountering ambiguous, out-of-distribution scenarios, questioning current paths to general cognitive versatility. (source: https://x.com/fchollet/status/2078526645108138382)
title_cn: AI 模型中指令遵循与稳健决策之间的脱节
summary_cn: AI 研究员 Francois Chollet 强调了生成式模型能力的日益分化，指出尽管系统在遵循精确指令方面表现出指数级的改进，但其在陌生环境下的自主决策能力却陷入了停滞。目前的架构擅长基于规则的过程执行，但在遇到模糊、分布外（out-of-distribution）的场景时无法进行泛化，这引发了人们对实现通用认知多功能性路径的质疑。

title: Gary Marcus and Miles Brundage Review AGI Capability Bet Progress
summary: Gary Marcus and Miles Brundage have evaluated the midpoint progress of their multi-year AGI wager initiated in late 2024. The bet relies on ten specific capabilities that a true Artificial General Intelligence must achieve, with a final assessment deadline scheduled for the end of 2027. The review assesses whether current AI models align with the defined benchmarks. Marcus also reinforced his skepticism alongside Demis Hassabis, arguing that current architectures remain fundamentally distant from true AGI. (source: https://x.com/GaryMarcus/status/2078292930234843554)
title_cn: Gary Marcus 和 Miles Brundage 回顾 AGI 能力赌约进度
summary_cn: Gary Marcus 和 Miles Brundage 评估了他们于 2024 年底发起的多年度 AGI 赌约的阶段性进展。该赌约依赖于真正通用人工智能（AGI）必须实现的十项具体能力，最终评估截止日期定于 2027 年底。此次回顾评估了当前的 AI 模型是否符合既定基准。Marcus 还与 Demis Hassabis 一道表达了怀疑态度，认为目前的架构距离真正的 AGI 依然非常遥远。

title: Creating Dreamy Cloud Gateways Using Kling AI Video Generation Tools
summary: Kling AI has released a prompt engineering tutorial demonstrating how to use its generative video platform to synthesize high-fidelity, surreal environmental transitions. The guide details workflow parameters and prompting strategies to generate dreamlike visual doorways opening into detailed cloud landscapes. This release showcases the model's capabilities in temporal consistency, spatial coherence, and cinematic video synthesis, targeting creative professionals. (source: https://x.com/Kling_ai/status/2078495005241700399)
title_cn: 使用 Kling AI 视频生成工具创建梦幻般的云端之门
summary_cn: Kling AI 发布了一份提示词工程教程，展示了如何使用其生成式视频平台合成高保真、超现实的环境过渡效果。该指南详细说明了生成通往精细云端景观的梦幻视觉门户所需的工作流参数和提示策略。此次发布展示了该模型在时间一致性、空间连贯性和电影级视频合成方面的能力，旨在服务创意专业人士。

title: Experience Interactive Sports Creativity With Magnific and Kling AI Collaboration
summary: Kling AI and Magnific have partnered to launch an interactive content generation workflow tailored for sports-themed media creation. The integration combines Kling's generative video technology with Magnific's high-resolution enhancement capabilities, allowing digital creators, marketers, and enthusiasts to generate and edit high-fidelity, customized sports imagery and dynamic video sequences. (source: https://x.com/Kling_ai/status/2078330283590660156)
title_cn: 通过 Magnific 和 Kling AI 的合作体验交互式体育创作
summary_cn: Kling AI 与 Magnific 合作推出了一款专为体育主题媒体创作定制的交互式内容生成工作流。该集成将 Kling 的生成式视频技术与 Magnific 的高分辨率增强能力相结合，使数字创作者、营销人员和爱好者能够生成并编辑高保真、定制化的体育图像及动态视频序列。
